description: Defines the CookieInclusionStatus class and related enums for managing cookie inclusion/exclusion reasons and warnings, including serialization, debugging, and testing utilities.

classes.name: net::CookieInclusionStatus
classes.description: Represents the inclusion/exclusion status of a cookie, reasons for exclusion, warnings, and serialization/deserialization support.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for CookieInclusionStatus.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for CookieInclusionStatus.

methods.name: IsInclude
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is included with no exclusion reasons.

methods.name: HasExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific exclusion reason is present.

methods.name: HasOnlyExclusionReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific exclusion reason is the only one present.

methods.name: AddExclusionReason
methods.description: Adds an exclusion reason.

methods.name: RemoveExclusionReason
methods.description: Removes a specific exclusion reason.

methods.name: RemoveExclusionReasons
methods.description: Removes multiple exclusion reasons.

methods.name: MaybeClearSameSiteWarning
methods.description: Clears warnings related to SameSite reasons if other exclusion reasons exist.

methods.name: ShouldRecordDowngradeMetrics
methods.description: Determines if downgrade metrics should be recorded.

methods.name: ShouldWarn
methods.description: Checks if the cookie should be warned about.

methods.name: HasWarningReason
methods.description: Checks if a specific warning reason is present.

methods.name: HasSchemefulDowngradeWarning
methods.description: Checks for schemeful downgrade warnings.

methods.name: AddWarningReason
methods.description: Adds a warning reason.

methods.name: RemoveWarningReason
methods.description: Removes a warning reason.

methods.name: GetBreakingDowngradeMetricsEnumValue
methods.description: Returns enum value for downgrade metrics based on URL.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the exclusion reasons and warnings.

methods.name: HasExactlyExclusionReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if exclusion reasons match a given set (for testing).

methods.name: HasExactlyWarningReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Checks if warning reasons match a given set (for testing).

methods.name: ValidateExclusionAndWarningFromWire
methods.description: Validates serialized data for exclusion and warning reasons.

methods.name: MakeFromReasonsForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CookieInclusionStatus with specified reasons for testing.

methods.name: ExcludedByUserPreferences
methods.description: Checks if cookie was excluded due to user preferences.
